note: The engine writes عم as أم (dropped ع, S4) in every uncle/cousin line (أمي = عمي, أمتي = عمتي). Plural rules: invented broken plurals are vocab tier 2 per READER-BRIEF (D3, D7, D8, D17); singular/plural mix-ups and a count needing a plural are grammar (D9 E1, D12 A9). At D4 Amal first stated a number-order rule, then withdrew it herself (واحد مهندس = 'one is an engineer'), so only the gender slip is kept.

row.why: He used على for 'above' (he then asked 'is above على?'); Amal said لا and he reached فوق راسي at 23:31. Sheet: up / above | Foaq | فوق. A different lexical item, not a preposition-choice rule.
row.english: from the ground to above my head

rulings.why: Wrong word for 'above'; فوق is a sheet word, so vocab tier 1 rather than grammar D1.

row.medi_said: أخوي آآ مح-- أخوي محمد، or محمد؟
row.amal_said: محامي. It's long and it's not doubled.
row.why: For 'lawyer' he said a short doubled form like the name Muhammad twice; Amal recast محامي and named the difference. Sheet: lawyer | Mu7aami | محامي.

rulings.why: Amal's own comment (long, not doubled) proves he produced a different form, and he asked which it was; it is a wrong form of a sheet word, kept at medium since it borders on S4.

row.why: Invented plural of عم; the أفعال hint (باب، ضوء، شال) points to أعمام, and Amal later recast أعمامي (38:32) and gave أعمام (39:41). Here she let it pass with Mm-hmm.

rulings.why: Real invented plural that Amal let pass at this moment; an invented plural pattern is vocab tier 2 per READER-BRIEF, so kind vocab-B not grammar-B.

row.why: He was talking about his uncles (masculine) and said واحدة; Amal recast واحد twice (31:03, 31:05). The word order was not wrong: Amal ended with 'You would say واحد مهندس' (31:11) for 'one is an engineer'.

rulings.why: The error that survives is gender on واحدة; the order point was withdrawn by Amal herself at 31:11, so the row is rewritten to واحدة -> واحد.

row.medi_said: أستاذ مهندس. أستاذ مهندس؟ Or مهندس الأستاذ؟ No، أستاذ مهندس.
row.amal_said: أستاذ هندسة. We would use the noun here. أستاذ هندسة.
row.why: He used the person noun 'engineer' where the field noun 'engineering' is needed; Amal: 'we would use the noun here. أستاذ هندسة'.

rulings.why: Wrong form of a known word (person noun for field noun); A6 is about where ال lands, which is not the issue here.

row.medi_said: عالمة، okay. So is it مـعـالمة؟ ... There's no M?
row.why: After first trying مال (34:56) he offered معالمة with an م- prefix; Amal repeated عالمة and said No.

rulings.why: He produced a wrong form and Amal said No explicitly.

row.why: Invented plural of عم (also أماو at 38:15; engine writes عم as أم, a dropped ع); Amal recast أعمامي.

rulings.why: Same slip described by both readers; an invented broken plural is vocab tier 2 per READER-BRIEF.

row.medi_said: Okay. And then would I say أماو، أم ماو؟ What was the plural for أم، أم مو؟
row.why: A minute after the 38:32 recast he still offered أماو and asked; Amal gave أعمام.

rulings.why: He produced the wrong form again and asked, so it is not a pure tier 0 didn't-know; it is a separate moment from D7.

row.medi_said: ابن أمي، أم، أم مو، أم.
row.amal_said: No. What's we don't say ابن. No. We make it plural for ولد. ... We say ولاد عم.
row.why: After 'وتسع' (nine, 40:00) he used singular ابن; a 3-10 count needs the plural, and Amal said No, the plural is ولاد عم (one = ابن عم).

rulings.why: The fix is number: singular after a count of nine. That is a grammar rule (E1, with A9 plurals), not a new word.

row.why: Asked for 'relatives' he offered قريبًا then قريبة; Amal said No to each (engine writes her echo as أديبة) and he reached قرايب at 47:29.

rulings.why: Wrong form of the known word قريب; explicit No.
S4 pronunciation: أخوتي vs إخوتي differs only in the first vowel; Amal answered أهـم (yes) before repeating it with the i-vowel.

row.why: He gave the plural (أحفاد, letters swapped = S4) when 'grandchild' was asked; Amal said that is plural, what's one?, and he said حفيد.

rulings.why: Singular/plural mix-up (he said himself 'I always mix up the plural and the singular'), so it is grammar A9, not a wrong word.

row.medi_said: بين عشرين و، وو آآآ سبعطاش،

row.amal_said: شو يعني عصبية؟ ... عصبية is an angry woman ... صبايا.
row.why: Amal's echo 'شو يعني عصبية؟' and her joke 'عصبية is an angry woman' suggest he said عصبية (engine wrote سبية) for صبية 'young woman'. Low because the engine also writes her own صبية ambiguously.

rulings.why: Follows the trust-Amal's-echo rule, but kept at low confidence because the audio is ambiguous.

row.why: Plural subject الولاد with singular بيكون and plural ولاد; parallel to his بتكون بنت and his next بيكون شاب, the singular ولد is meant (my reading). Amal said ممتاز at 57:29 without a fix.
row.english: under eleven, he is a boy

rulings.why: Number does not match between subject, verb and predicate; the verb-agreement rule B18 is the core, not a plural pattern.

row.why: Wrong plural of جار after her 'like walls, like teeth' hint (حيطان، سنان); Amal recast جيران.

rulings.why: An invented plural form is vocab tier 2 per READER-BRIEF; kind set to vocab-A to match D7/D8.
Not tier 3: in context (هي beside أخوي ... not with ... في بناته) he means 'besides / apart from', not 'next to', so the sheet row جنب does not fit; Amal's إن is unclear and there is no fix.

row.amal_said: Actually we never put ل. آخر واحد.
row.why: He is naming the last uncle (masculine) and said واحدة; Amal's recast is آخر واحد, and he repeated واحدة at 32:51 before fixing it himself.

rulings.why: Real gender slip that Amal's recast fixed, separate from the ال point she named.
